leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply outline and border properties to HTML elements using CSS syntax
Construct visual examples that demonstrate the spatial relationship between border and outline
Configure distinct styling for border and outline to create layered visual effects
Manipulate outline-offset to control the spacing between border and outline
Implement interactive states where outline appears on focus while border maintains consistent styling
Integrate outline and border together to create accessible focus indicators
Update existing CSS rules to replace border with outline where appropriate for accessibility
